basis: CSX’s October 19, 2023 release establishes that Q3 consolidated GAAP revenue was $3,572 million versus $3,895 million a year earlier, down 8.29% and below the $3,700.25 million threshold. October 19 is the earliest qualifying disclosure I could verify. The onset date remains null because I could verify the September 6 conference host’s account but could not check the CEO’s complete remarks and Q&A for an earlier quarter-specific revenue bound.

coverage.detail: April 20, preceding earnings cycle. CSX reported Q1 revenue of $3.71 billion, up 9%. The release gave no Q3 consolidated revenue range.

April 20, slide 20. CSX projected low-single-digit full-year growth in revenue ton-miles, a freight volume measure, and an approximately $300 million decline in supplemental revenue. Neither figure bounds Q3 consolidated revenue.
July 20, immediately preceding release. The $3.70 billion revenue figure and 3% year-over-year decline were Q2 actuals. Management discussed the second half qualitatively.

July 20, slide 19. CSX retained its full-year ton-mile outlook and expected the roughly $300 million supplemental-revenue decline to weigh more heavily in the second half. It supplied no consolidated Q3 revenue ceiling.
July 20 call. Kevin Boone did give a Q3-specific forecast of a mid-teens sequential decline in coal revenue per unit. Both the revenue measure and the comparison period differ from the test.
August 4, Exhibit 99.1 announced operations executive Jamie Boychuk’s departure. It contained no sales outlook.
CSX identified CFO Sean Pelkey as its speaker at the August 15 Deutsche Bank transportation conference and announced a public webcast.

August 15 Q&A. Deutsche Bank analyst Amit Mehrotra suggested a mid-to-high-single-digit year-over-year revenue decline. Pelkey answered the question about mix, quantifying the expected decline in coal revenue per unit and discussing storage and merchandise pricing. He did not endorse the analyst’s consolidated revenue estimate.

September 6 TD Cowen conference. The host’s September 7 account says CSX reaffirmed low-single-digit full-year revenue ton-mile growth. The account gives no consolidated Q3 revenue bound. It summarizes the session, leaving the full Q&A unverified.
September 6 Form 8-K disclosed the underwriting agreement for $600 million of notes due 2033.
September 7 Form 8-K disclosed completion of the debt offering. The dollar amount represents note principal.
September 8, Exhibit 99.1 announced Mike Cory’s appointment as chief operating officer. It contained no revenue guidance.
September 21, CSX scheduled the Q3 release for after market close on October 19. The scheduling notice contained no preliminary results.

October 19, Exhibit 99.2. The consolidated income statements give revenue in millions for the quarters ended September 30, 2023 and 2022. The $3,572 million and $3,895 million figures appear together on the same reported revenue line.

publication_date_evidence: CSX’s investor-relations release is dated October 19, 2023. Its dateline says CSX announced Q3 results that day, and the accompanying quarterly financial report carries the same dateline. This verifies publication of the actuals before the October 20 Form 10-Q. https://investors.csx.com/news-and-events/news/news-details/2023/CSX-Corp.-Announces-Third-Quarter-2023-Results/default.aspx
